info.title: 101cloud Backend API
info.description: Implemented Go/Gin/MySQL/GORM control plane. Numeric IDs and money are strings; time is RFC3339 +08:00. No NAT or arbitrary Incus proxy. Custom-instance applications happen outside the platform; only administrators provision or import custom instances, with approved_config retained as the public configuration field, not an approval record. No custom-instance application or review operations exist. List items use exactly the same representation as the resource detail: JSON columns are decoded objects/arrays (never JSON-encoded strings), booleans are true/false (never 1/0), every revision is a decimal string. Every policy version reference in requests and responses (pricing_version_id, gpu_price_version_id, policy_version_id, policy_versions values, catalog gpu-option id) is a policy_versions id as returned by /admin/policies/{kind}/versions; an id of the wrong kind is 422 validation_failed. See 后端接口文档.md for workflow and policy boundaries.

get.description: Member-owned read-only repeatable snapshot, one server clock, fixed +08 calendar. No user/account selector; unknown, duplicate, malformed query parameters rejected. No explicit credit account returns 409 policy_not_configured. Consumption is expected usage, including unpaid costs, excluding cancelled/failed-creation/admin-exempt usage and all grants/holds/ledger transfers. Unclosed known billable tails are separate estimates; partial/reasons disclose uncertainty. Six-fraction exact strings; breakdown conserves consumed micro-Pt. No settlement, financial locks or Agent calls. All-account hero, unaffected by instance filters. Period summaries end at as_of. Forecast is only the exact static conversion floor(balance.available_pt * 3600 / current.hourly_pt), using the raw six-place values, not rounded display values. It does not truncate at expiry or daily refresh, assume future grants, or deduct pending usage, unclosed tails, debt or reservations again. Available balance still excludes currently invalid buckets and subtracts reservations and reported debt once. This is not an actual shutdown deadline. Historical usage partial alone does not prevent a known balance/rate conversion.

Own-wallet read-only repeatable snapshot; as_of captured after account read. Only one required period accepted; unknown, duplicate and malformed query parameters return 422, missing own wallet returns 409 policy_not_configured. Natural Asia/Shanghai calendar, Monday week start; from is period start, to=as_of. Unpaged union of owned observed-running nondeleted nonfailed instances (including free/exempt/zero) and owned instances with positive net period consumption (including stopped/unknown/deleted history). Creation failures excluded immediately. Duplicate names retain distinct IDs. Sort consumed descending then numeric ID descending; no TopN or Other. All six-place decimal strings; sum instances = sum breakdown = consumed = recorded + estimated. Known unclosed tails are estimated; partial/reasons disclose uncertainty. Summary SQL plus exact raw complement and lightweight tails only; no wallet forecast, financial mutation or Agent query.

Member-owned read-only repeatable snapshot, one server clock, fixed +08 calendar. No user/account selector; unknown, duplicate, malformed query parameters rejected. No explicit credit account returns 409 policy_not_configured. Consumption is expected usage, including unpaid costs, excluding cancelled/failed-creation/admin-exempt usage and all grants/holds/ledger transfers. Unclosed known billable tails are separate estimates; partial/reasons disclose uncertainty. Six-fraction exact strings; breakdown conserves consumed micro-Pt. No settlement, financial locks or Agent calls. Full calendar axis; to is the next calendar boundary, future amounts null (not zero), elapsed empty buckets zero, current bucket partial. today/hour, week/day, month/day, year/month. Cross-boundary charges use differences of rounded cumulative prefixes.

Member-owned read-only repeatable snapshot, one server clock, fixed +08 calendar. No user/account selector; unknown, duplicate, malformed query parameters rejected. No explicit credit account returns 409 policy_not_configured. Consumption is expected usage, including unpaid costs, excluding cancelled/failed-creation/admin-exempt usage and all grants/holds/ledger transfers. Unclosed known billable tails are separate estimates; partial/reasons disclose uncertainty. Six-fraction exact strings; breakdown conserves consumed micro-Pt. No settlement, financial locks or Agent calls. Lists only owned instances with deleted_at IS NULL, including running, stopped and zero-consumption instances; deleted-instance costs remain in account-wide reports and distributions. Search is literal name substring or exact numeric ID. Sort consumed descending then ID descending. Page pagination and total apply the same nondeleted filter; to=as_of. A foreign/missing instance_id returns 404; an owned deleted instance_id returns an empty list.
get.x-existing-instance-filter: deleted_at IS NULL AND creation_failed_at IS NULL; identical visibility to the member instance list; no running-state restriction

get.description: Authenticated self-only published successful events, ordered occurred_at DESC, id DESC. One read-only repeatable-read snapshot and one clock after snapshot establishment. Asia/Shanghai calendar, Monday-start week, from inclusive, to exclusive, occurred_at <= as_of. No account required or created, no settlement, financial locks, Agent calls or raw usage aggregation. No historical backfill. Failed creation drafts are hidden; publishing preserves their original transaction clock. Creation admission/held reservations are not success and built-in creation startup is not an independent start event. Available balances are eligible remaining less reserved and outstanding insufficient debt at the same grant clock. Hourly snapshots are account-wide frozen active/running metering-session nominal Pt/h including parallel CPU/memory/storage/GPU, not utilization or current catalog prices. Unknown metering, pricing, policy, grace evidence or deferred offline usage produces null rather than zero. Unknown, duplicate or malformed parameters return 422; no ownership or instance selectors. Nullable snapshots mean unavailable or inapplicable, not zero. Internal ownership, business key and publication fields are not exposed.

Owned nondeleted instance identities, including running, stopped and zero-cost instances, sorted by ID descending. Both items and total exclude deleted_at IS NOT NULL. No wallet or explicit credit account required. Read-only repeatable snapshot without financial aggregates, live usage, forecasts or Agent calls. Search trims whitespace and matches literal name substring or exact ID. Unknown, duplicate or malformed parameters return 422.

get.description: Anonymous no-store availability only. enabled=false when registration is disabled or the configured credit policy is no longer usable. No administrator defaults are disclosed.

post.description: Self-register an active ordinary user, atomically copying current default limits, creating a credit account, granting its full current business-cycle daily allowance, and writing audit. The cycle follows policy timezone and grant_time: before today's reset, use the previous business_date, never a future cycle. Uses daily source, daily:YYYY-MM-DD key, daily record and cursor; no extra gift or prorating. Initial valid_from is registration time; expires_at is the earlier of registration time plus daily_validity_seconds and the next policy calendar reset. Daily quota never rolls over; only daily funds reset to the policy amount, while redemption and administrator grants retain their own expiry. Same-cycle polling/restarts never refill consumed quota. Missed closed cycles are skipped. Zero allowance records a zero bucket and cycle without a zero-value ledger entry. Any failure rolls back users, limits, account, funds and audit together. Manual administrator account creation is unchanged. Same-origin CSRF required; no Idempotency-Key and no automatic login. 403 registration_disabled, 409 username_taken, 422 validation_failed, 429 rate_limited with Retry-After. Unknown fields, including role/limits/policy, are rejected.

delete.description: Administrator deletion requires exact confirm_name and delete_data:true. Normal deletion keeps ready/fresh state gates and strict post-delete GPU evidence (see Task.phase); manual GPU detachment is not required when the target is absent and observed shared ownership is fully explained by other instances. This is target reservation release, not a claim that another owner's CUDA memory was reclaimed or the physical card is idle. Explicit cleanup_stuck:true additionally requires mode:force and confirm_data_loss_risk:true; it may take over busy/pending/unknown/stale instances, durably revoke old task leases and reuse an active cleanup task. Known native operations must reach terminal state before authoritative target absence; initially absent is success without stop/delete or host-wide GPU metrics. Matching native UUID/ownership is required for present guests. Resources and billing reservations are released once while preserving a deleted_at tombstone, historical charges and audit. Offline/403/timeouts are not absence; unresolved lost operation identity remains unknown with cleanup_native_submission_unknown and recovery guidance.

mode.description: Must be force when deleting a running instance; administrator only. The durable task persists force=true.

confirm_data_loss_risk.description: Must be true with mode:force for a running instance or cleanup_stuck:true. Force stop may lose unsaved data.

cleanup_stuck.description: Administrator-only explicit recovery cleanup. Requires mode:force, confirm_data_loss_risk:true, exact confirm_name and delete_data:true. Revokes prior tasks, resolves known native operations, and treats verified target absence as sufficient cleanup success without host-wide GPU metrics.

post.description: Submit the same durable admin deletion/cleanup contract as DELETE /admin/instances/{id}.

put.description: Administrator required. Replaces GPU policy and may explicitly replace allowed_user_actions and gpu_user_permissions on elastic or custom instances; empty arrays/maps revoke permissions. Platform and hardware safety restrictions still apply.

Elastic instances, existing bindings, or any historical allocation return 409 policy_binding_frozen. Never replaces a frozen binding or reprices allocations. Returns policy_versions, revision, and updated ETag.

post.description: Create with optional login credentials, only for the exact selected node/project image with cloud_init=true (otherwise 409 image_login_unsupported). login is accepted only here, never in quotes. Passwords are hashed with salted SHA-512 crypt and MasterKey-encrypted before persistence; neither credentials nor hashes appear in DTOs, tasks, audit or ordinary snapshots. An uncertain response must be retried with the identical original body and Idempotency-Key. Login cloud-init completion is awaited once independently of administrator templates; no SSH software is installed automatically. New user-data preserves the Incus-assigned hostname. Before first start, new cloud-init-capable containers journal identity-bound stopped-guest preparation through HostAgent, verifying installed cloud-init and safely creating the fixed root-owned preserve_hostname system configuration before removing /etc/cloud/cloud-init.disabled. An existing conflicting system configuration is never overwritten. Preparation failures prevent start; existing/imported guests, restarts, source images and VMs are not modified by this container-only step.

delete.description: Ordinary deletion requires an owned stopped, ready instance with fresh state, exact confirm_name and delete_data:true. Manual GPU detachment is not required: ordinary deletion still verifies native identity, durable delete intent and authoritative absence, then fresh post-confirmation complete host evidence (see Task.phase). The narrow known-other-shared-owner exception releases only the absent target's reservations, not another owner's CUDA memory; unknown evidence retains IP/GPU/quota/usage/credit reservations. Explicit cleanup_stuck:true additionally requires mode:force and confirm_data_loss_risk:true and the current owner's existing delete grant (including custom restrictions). Only this explicit DELETE recovery intent bypasses busy/task-barrier, provisioning and freshness gates; standalone member force stop/restart/delete remains forbidden. It reuses the durable cleanup task engine, revokes old task leases, and releases resources only after authoritative native absence. Ordinary deletes never use this recovery path to skip GPU verification. Hidden failed creations and deleted rows remain unavailable. ETag, CSRF and idempotency checks are unchanged; retry uncertain requests with the identical body/key/ETag.

get.description: Returns stored and effective GPU policy, frozen instance-bound policy ranges, and six per-field editable flags. For any nonadministrator, editable requires both gpu_policy in the instance action allowlist and the corresponding gpu_user_permissions flag; missing flags are false.

put.description: Replaces all idle/rebalance fields. Both elastic and custom nonadministrators require gpu_policy in allowed_user_actions, and each changed field requires its matching gpu_user_permissions flag. Unchanged unauthorized fields may be round-tripped. Frozen instance policy bounds and container safety checks remain enforced.

post.description: Stop orchestration for any queued/running/waiting/unknown task initiated by the current member. Resource ownership alone is insufficient; system credit enforcement and administrator-initiated tasks return 403 task_stop_not_allowed. Revokes leases and execution contexts, including recovery source/wrapper chains. Does not promise physical cancellation. Proven predispatch instance.gpu cancellation restores only own releasing sources, releases only own unconfigured/unobserved reserved targets and ends only held target usage; active/configured targets and historical billing remain intact. Unknown status alone is not dispatch proof; ambiguous/dispatched work retains its safety barrier. Terminal tasks are returned unchanged.

200.description: Stopped orchestration or unchanged terminal task. ETag identifies returned revision.

post.description: Administrator may stop every task type and owner, including system tasks. Same durable cancellation and retained-external-state semantics as member force-stop; does not clear enforcement debt or fabricate physical cancellation. Requires explicit confirm:true.

200.description: Stopped orchestration or unchanged terminal task, with ETag.

post.description: Administrator required. Pure additions preserve every native configured GPU and use the internal Agent add_only guard; an extra native GPU outside the desired set rejects instead of being implicitly detached. Running additions require fresh complete collection and matching instance project/name/UUID/running state. Normally full attribution is required; an explicit Agent quality.context_attribution_complete:true with gpu_shared_control_references and only metric-level companion reasons may authorize additions, never removal/rebind/idle/reclamation. Missing context evidence does not grant an exception. Upgrade Agent first; unsupported add_only is rejected without an unguarded retry. Quota, pricing, inventory and independent GPU load freshness gates remain unchanged.

get.description: Administrator read-only preview using the instance owner's quota, node capacity and custom resident budget. No capacity bypass, agent query, pricing or reservation; missing quota or unavailable node fails closed.

post.description: Administrator resize within owner quota, node capacity and resident budget; disk shrinking is forbidden. A running instance requires confirm_restart:true and one durable backend task gracefully stops, confirms configuration, then restarts it; a stopped instance stays stopped. No client stop/start choreography. Recovery never replays stop or resize after start intent.

confirm_restart.description: Optional for stopped instances; must be true for running instances to authorize graceful stop, resize and restart in one durable task.

post.description: Administrator required. Commits the signed adjustment and synchronous historical-debt repayment atomically before returning 201. Positive grants repay historical debt first. remaining_pt and available_pt subtract outstanding_debt_pt, so balances can be negative while debt remains; reserved_pt is unchanged and subtracted once for available_pt. Same-key replay returns the original committed result without granting twice.

201.description: Committed adjustment and fresh account balances after historical-debt repayment

Optional top-level write-only login uses the member-create credential contract and requires a ready cloud-init-capable image on the exact node/project. Omit login for existing network-only behavior. Never put credentials in approved_config or init_parameters; imports do not accept login. Retry uncertain outcomes with the identical body and Idempotency-Key.

post.description: Administrator required. Unknown tasks use their safe reconciler. Force-stopped tasks use GET-only external reconciliation without replay or native mutations; original cancelled history remains intact. Historical instance.gpu barriers may clear only with proven predispatch safety: restore only own releasing sources, release only own unconfigured/unobserved reserved targets and end only held target usage. Preserve active/configured targets and historical billing. Unknown status alone is not dispatch proof; dispatched or ambiguous tasks remain locked.
Wrong username or password (including unknown or disabled accounts) returns 401 invalid_credentials with a generic message. 429 rate_limited with Retry-After per client IP and account.

post.description: Adds count GPUs without stopping existing CUDA work. Every native configured GPU must remain in the desired set; the internal Agent add_only guard preserves existing device entries under native read/ETag protection. Running additions require fresh complete collection and matching instance project/name/UUID/running state. Full attribution remains the normal gate. Its only additive exception requires explicit Agent quality.context_attribution_complete:true plus gpu_shared_control_references, with optional gpu_metric_unavailable, gpu_utilization_unknown, gpu_utilization_no_samples, gpu_utilization_stale or gpu_utilization_identity_unconfirmed reasons and no other reasons. Old Agent without context evidence still requires full attribution; unsupported add_only never triggers an unguarded fallback. Removal, rebind, idle/release, pricing, quota and inventory/load freshness gates are not relaxed.

session.name: __Host-101cloud_session
session.description: HttpOnly session cookie. Name depends on the CLOUD_ORIGIN scheme: https -> __Host-101cloud_session (Secure); http (local development only) -> 101cloud_session (not Secure). The CSRF browser-context cookie follows the same rule (__Host-101cloud_csrf / 101cloud_csrf).

seconds.description: Nonnegative whole-second string: exact decimal floor(balance.available_pt * 3600 / current.hourly_pt). Known positive rate with nonpositive balance gives exhausted and 0; known zero rate gives not_consuming and null seconds. Unknown rate, inconsistent wallet or inactive account gives unavailable. No expiry/refresh cutoff, future grants or second deduction of pending usage, tails, debt or reservations.

exhausts_at.description: Static as_of + seconds, not an actual shutdown or grace deadline. Null if the calendar timestamp is out of range, while computable seconds remains valid.

RegistrationLimits.description: Complete limits; zero denies new allocations. max_resident_instances must not exceed max_instances.

credit_policy_version_id.description: Public credit policy ID, not source ID. Required active/effective when enabling.
Public credit policy ID, not source ID. Required active/effective when enabling.

AccountPasswordInput.description: 8–128 Unicode code points, including ASCII uppercase A–Z, lowercase a–z and digits 0–9. Other characters are allowed but do not replace these classes. Whitespace is preserved. Applies only when setting an account password, not login/current-password verification or instance root passwords.

CreditAccount.description: Public account balance. Exact six-fractional-digit strings: remaining_pt = internal remaining - outstanding_debt_pt; available_pt = remaining_pt - reserved_pt. Negative balances represent debt and are not clamped. settlement_pending is true when durable background settlement has currently payable historical debt; it does not claim the debt is already cleared. Short-expiry unreserved grants may expire before a worker consumes them; held reservation ownership survives expiry.

settlement_pending.description: Durable background settlement is pending; false does not change ledger history.

enforcements.description: Shutdown events for this shared wallet, grouped by each instance's frozen credit policy; empty array when none. Each event retains id/status/exhausted_at/shutdown_deadline/instance_ids/policy_version_id.

CreditAdjustmentResult.description: Committed adjustment snapshot. Positive grants commit only the bucket and grant ledger synchronously; settled_debt_pt is always 0.000000 in this response. A durable worker settles historical debt in bounded chunks and settlement_pending reports whether currently payable work remains. Short-expiry unreserved credit may expire before processing; held reservations retain ownership through expiry. Point amounts are exact six-fractional-digit decimal strings; remaining_pt and available_pt may be negative. Idempotent replay returns this original snapshot rather than current balances.

bucket_id.description: New bucket ID for a positive grant; null for a negative adjustment.

expires_at.description: Positive grant expiry, or null for no expiry and for negative adjustments.

settlement_pending.description: Historical settlement is durably queued or currently payable.

revision.description: Account revision after committed adjustment and durable scheduling.

max_resources.description: Total allowed instance size, excluding its own reservation; min of owner quota, node capacity and custom resident budget. Not an increment or a reservation; POST revalidates. Plan bounds and disk no-shrink still apply.

PolicyVersions.description: Explicit policy_versions.id values, never internal source IDs. pricing/credit/metrics are always required; containers additionally require gpu-idle/gpu-scheduling. gpu-pricing is required for GPU-capable container plans (including optional GPU count) and custom containers with count > 0. Bindings are frozen on instance admission and never follow later plan changes; credit here governs instance storage/grace, not the independent user wallet allowance.

name.description: Optional and ignored for configuration quotes. Creating an instance still requires a valid name.

plan_revision.description: Optional quote freshness guard; mismatch returns 409 plan_changed.

gpu.description: Only count/model/access_mode/max_hourly_pt apply. max_hourly_pt is a nonnegative DECIMAL(20,6) string and must not exceed the plan cap even when count is 0. count 0 opts out on any plan regardless of its base count or gpu_count.min; model must be null, access_mode is not compared with the offering and GPU charge is 0. count > 0 requires a GPU-capable container plan, count equal to the base or within allowed_overrides.gpu_count min/max/step, matching model/access_mode, a GPU-ready image and gpu-pricing policy. Violations return 422 validation_failed.

plan_revision.description: Required revision returned by quote; mismatch returns 409 plan_changed before side effects.

gpu.description: Same rules as ElasticSpec.gpu, including the plan price cap when count is 0. Admission snapshots the plan GPU policy and user permissions; the instance rebalance cap uses this admitted request cap.

InstanceLogin.description: Write-only root password OR SSH public keys; exactly one nonempty credential mode. Final POST /instances and POST /admin/custom-instances only, at the request top level. Never accepted by quotes, approved_config or instance imports.

root_password.description: 8–128 Unicode characters, no controls; whitespace preserved. Mutually exclusive with nonempty ssh_public_keys.

ssh_public_keys.description: At most 10 entries before dedup, each <=8192 UTF-8 bytes including comments. Ed25519, RSA >=2048 bits, ECDSA P-256/384/521. Reject private keys, certificates, options and malformed keys; strip comments and deduplicate canonical keys. Mutually exclusive with nonempty root_password.

node_id.description: Required for POST /admin/custom-instances; imports use the route node, and a supplied value must match it.

InitializationFailureDetails.description: Safe initialization diagnostic only. exit_code is the ORIGINAL wait/script process exit, never the diagnostic probe exit. Absence means no valid original exit was observed. A fixed, output-disabled read-only probe interprets cloud-init status JSON locally; raw JSON, logs, stderr, credentials, hashes, user-data and environment never leave the guest or enter task results. ssh_host_key_generation_missing_tool requires BOTH a current cloud-init host-key warning and missing ssh-keygen; missing tool alone is not a cause. Exit 137 means terminated, not proven timeout. Existing unknown/no-replay/resource-retention semantics are unchanged.

action.description: Fixed safe Chinese administrator guidance; never raw script output.

PublicTaskError.description: Explicitly public safe error only. Resource amounts in details are decimal strings, never floating-point numbers; no raw upstream output or parameters. For unknown deletion tasks, gpu_reclamation_unverified means native deletion is confirmed but independent post-deletion target release evidence is not: details include stage=delete.verify_reclamation, safe reason, native_deletion_confirmed=true, resource_reservations_released=false and a Chinese action. Keep all IP/GPU/quota/usage/credit reservations and reconcile the original task; do not issue another DELETE. Complete known-other-owner shared context evidence may authorize only the absent target's reservation release, never physical-card idleness or reclamation of other CUDA memory. No raw GPU process data is exposed.

code.description: Initialization codes: initialization_cloud_init_degraded, initialization_cloud_init_failed, initialization_tool_missing, initialization_marker_missing, initialization_password_not_ready, initialization_script_failed, initialization_timeout, initialization_result_unknown, initialization_diagnostic_unavailable. Task status remains unknown when outcome/resource release is uncertain.

can_force_stop.description: Role and trusted initiating-actor capability; never infer authorization from type or owner alone.

creation_cleanup.description: Only retired never-delivered instance.create tasks. Original error and instance_id remain available; this safe summary does not expose instance configuration.

creation_progress.description: Only instance.create. Read-only journal projection; task success alone does not imply completed initialization.

phase.description: Deletion progresses through delete.native, delete.verify_reclamation and delete.finalize. After verified native identity, durable delete intent and native absence, active GPU allocations wait up to about 95 seconds for collection_started_at strictly after this confirmation, valid ordered timestamps, collected_at age <=30 seconds, stale:false, collection_complete:true and an actual full instances array with complete identities and target UUID or target name/project absent. host_quality.attribution_complete:true remains the legacy path. The only alternative requires explicit host attribution_complete:false and context_attribution_complete:true, an actual reasons array containing gpu_shared_control_references and only metric companions gpu_metric_unavailable, gpu_utilization_unknown, gpu_utilization_no_samples, gpu_utilization_stale or gpu_utilization_identity_unconfirmed; all three anonymous counters (unattributed_contexts, unresolved_gpu_references, unattributed_activity_samples) must be explicit numeric zero. At least one non-target Running/Frozen holder row must explicitly have full:false/context:true and that same shared-only reason contract. Missing/malformed/unknown holders, duplicate UUID or name/project identities, structural reasons, anonymous/unresolved evidence or surviving target fail closed. Unrelated stopped rows on this alternative may only carry explicit quality/reasons with missing-runtime-PID or approved metric warnings, not unknown reference evidence; the legacy full:true path stays unchanged. Aggregate quality or total GPU memory never bypasses these gates. Release of target IP/GPU/quota/usage/credit is atomic and once; reconciliation never reissues native DELETE. This observed-evidence contract is not physical-card idle, zero memory, or proof of absence of every host FD-only handle. Verification failure remains unknown, not an assertion that native deletion failed. No new migration or protocol fields.

resource_reservations_released.description: True only after atomic, proven pre-dispatch creation reservation cancellation. False is not evidence that a guest exists.

result.description: Optional, image.prepare only. Public-safe string projection of task progress, never the raw native metadata/result object. Non-instance tasks have instance_id null; use the normal task reconcile endpoint for unknown preparation outcomes, which remain unknown without native evidence.

plan_snapshot.description: Frozen elastic admission baseline and override bounds used for resize; custom is null.

resource_reservations_released.description: Only a failed, proven never-dispatched creation with completed atomic reservation release reports true.

image_os_name.description: Source image OS name, including disabled or retired images; empty when unavailable. Never inferred from the instance name.

image_os_release.description: Source image OS release, including disabled or retired images; empty when unavailable.

allowed_user_actions.description: Frozen instance action allowlist, copied from the plan at elastic admission. Administrators alone bypass it.

creation_task_id.description: Stable original creation task ID; null for imported instances.

initialization_pending.description: Present for instances with a creation task; missing journal evidence remains pending.

login_mode.description: Frozen non-sensitive summary only; legacy configurations may be unknown.

active_task_status.description: Actual status of the same task selected by active_task_id, or null when no task is selected. A cancelled task may retain a safety barrier; it is not executing.

capabilities.description: UI hints only; the server reauthorizes every request against the instance allowed_user_actions for elastic and custom products. Only administrators bypass the action allowlist, not hardware/capacity or confirmation checks. Ordinary resize/delete require ready provisioning and fresh observed state. Ordinary running delete is administrator-only; explicit force_delete recovery is separately authorized by the current owner's delete grant and does not depend on busy, provisioning or state freshness. Running resize by nonadministrators additionally requires stop and start permissions.

resize.description: Whether stopped/running resize is available; running requests still require confirm_restart:true.

delete.description: Whether ordinary deletion is available; running ordinary deletion still requires administrator mode:force and explicit risk, exact-name and data confirmations.

force_delete.description: Explicit recovery cleanup authorization for a current owner-visible, nondeleted, nonretired instance with delete permission, independent of active tasks, provisioning or state freshness. Clients must require exactly true (absent/false fails closed). DELETE still requires cleanup_stuck:true, mode:force, risk acknowledgement, exact name, delete_data:true, CSRF, If-Match and Idempotency-Key.

Quality.description: Persisted public monitoring quality. Agent live quality separately supplies context_attribution_complete (explicit boolean) for verified context ownership; that internal flag is not persisted or returned by latest/history and never replaces full attribution for release or idle safety.

attribution_complete.description: Full context and device-reference safety evidence. Owned shared control references keep this false even when context ownership is verified.

items.description: Allowlisted anonymous reason. gpu_shared_control_references means shared control references belong to this instance but their physical GPU scope remains uncertain; reference_scan_quality is partial and verified numeric metrics may still be present.

LimitsView.description: Effective quota object returned by GET /me (limits), GET and PUT /admin/users/{id}/limits.

ConsoleSession.description: No fixed console duration. The bound login session and permissions must remain valid; expired is retained only for historical records.

metrics_policy_id.description: Explicit active/effective metrics policy_versions.id used by node collection and node queries; returned in Node DTOs. Instance queries use their frozen metrics binding.

CreditPolicy.description: Confirmed stop suspends CPU, memory, storage, and GPU charges. GPU bindings and capacity reservations remain until an explicit release; confirmed running resumes all applicable charges. Failed stop requests and unknown state do not imply stopped. Historical charges remain; undelivered-creation refunds are unchanged.

daily_validity_seconds.description: Maximum daily bucket lifetime in seconds; actual expiry is capped at the next reset in timezone/grant_time. Cannot enable rollover. Registration starts validity immediately; redemption and administrator grant expiry is unchanged.

shutdown_grace_seconds.description: Explicit configured grace; existing deadline events retain their captured value.

storage_charge_mode.description: running_only charges disk only while running; free never charges disk. Confirmed stop is free for every resource, regardless of retained capacity.

offline_charge_mode.description: Controls unconfirmed offline intervals only. Node offline is not instance stopped and does not override confirmed-stop free billing.

GPUIdlePolicy.description: GPU idle timing and permitted actions. Reclamation requires complete, fresh ownership evidence with zero GPU processes, device references and memory usage; percentage thresholds cannot override these fixed safety requirements.

gpu.description: Plan GPU offering: only count/model/access_mode/max_hourly_pt apply. VM plans require count 0, model null and no positive GPU override. Container plans with a model require positive count or an optional GPU override max >= 1, a gpu-pricing policy, and GPU-ready image configurations on every selected node/project. max_hourly_pt must equal gpu_policy.rebalance.max_hourly_pt numerically (DECIMAL(20,6)).

node_ids.description: Explicit node allowlist. All selected network bindings must belong to these nodes; each node needs at least one compatible selected network. Every selected image must resolve in every selected node/network project with compatible architecture; publication requires verified active online nodes, validated networks and ready images. This does not enable automatic placement or move instances.

gpu_policy.description: Initial instance policy. Timeout/action must fit the pinned gpu-idle policy even when disabled; enabled idle requires that policy to permit it. Price cap must equal gpu.max_hourly_pt. Omission defaults idle/rebalance/live to disabled and uses the pinned idle default timeout/action. VM plans cannot enable idle, rebalance or live migration.

allowed_user_actions.description: Copied to new instances. Omission defaults to start, stop, restart, console; explicit [] denies all listed user actions. VM plans reject GPU-specific actions.

gpu_user_permissions.description: Copied to new instances. Omission defaults to {}; explicit {} is preserved. VM plans cannot grant any true GPU edit permission.

PlanPatch.description: Partial update in active or disabled state. Omitted fields retain values. code/version are editable and unique together. Status is not patchable; active edits require fully ready references and placement.

Plan.description: Identical admin/public representation. Plans remain independently editable and enabled; edits affect future creation only. Existing instance resources, authorizations and resize bounds are frozen at admission.

pricing_version_id.description: Pricing policy-version ID, equal to policy_versions.pricing when configured.

AllowedUserActions.description: Allowlist for nonadministrator instance lifecycle/GPU actions and console access; [] grants none. A display-name rename is not one of these action identifiers.

GPUUserPermissions.description: Six GPU policy field-edit permissions; omitted keys mean false. idle controls idle.enabled; idle_timeout controls idle.timeout_seconds; idle_action controls idle.action; rebalance controls rebalance.enabled; allow_live and max_hourly_pt control the corresponding rebalance fields. Nonadministrators also need the gpu_policy action.

ElasticNodeID.description: Optional node assertion for quote/create. Must equal the selected network_option_id binding node and belong to the selected plan node_ids. Omission derives the node from that same binding; never arbitrary placement.

GPUPolicyView.description: GPU policy view includes the immutable pricing binding captured on this instance. gpu_binding is null when no pricing profile is bound; it never comes from the current plan or administrator catalog.

gpu_binding.description: Immutable instance-bound gpu-pricing source and rate; null only when the instance has no gpu-pricing binding.

effective_policy.description: Effective idle/rebalance and frozen instance policy safety requirements; may disable stored settings when blocked.

code.description: Optional. Empty or omitted defaults to the first 12 hex characters of fingerprint; the generated name then becomes "os_name os_release (code)".

version.description: Optional. Empty or omitted defaults to "1".

gpu_ready.description: Manual compatibility assertion; never installs GPU drivers.

source_id.description: Required for remote entries; forbidden for local entries.

ImageNode.description: Per-node effective configuration. IDs and revision are decimal strings; fingerprint is a full SHA-256 hex digest.

error.description: Public-safe structured error; no raw native output or credentials.

Image.description: Logical image. With node_id, architecture/fingerprint/gpu_ready/cloud_init/properties are resolved from a ready node configuration, never legacy global fallback.

ApiError.description: Structured API error; see error.code and request_id
